meta.name: Griha Laxmi
meta.description: Laxmi, a housewife in Betalgadh, stumbles upon weed during a police chase and starts selling it to save her family, navigating danger, secrets, and morality to become Betalgadh's queen of weed.

videos.title: Khatarnak Khel
videos.overview: In Betalgadh, India’s drug hub, Lakshmi, a struggling woman, finds abandoned sacks of marijuana and sees a chance to escape poverty. Meanwhile, ruthless drug lord Vikram Kandpal relentlessly hunts for his lost stash, leaving chaos in his wake.

videos.title: Hara Sona
videos.overview: In Betalgadh, IPS Balram Tokas battles the drug trade, while Lakshmi disrupts kingpin Vikram Kandpal with a new strain made from his stolen stash. Tensions peak when Vikram kidnaps her son, forcing a deadly showdown.

videos.title: Rani Ki Chaal
videos.overview: Lakshmi's world crumbles as debts, betrayal, and suspicions mount. After a risky drug deal, she's caught by Milan and Savita, forcing her to face the fallout of her double life.

videos.title: Maal Ki Mallika
videos.overview: Amid Tokas's raids, Lakshmi resolves to dominate the drug trade but nearly loses everything in a failed attempt to rob Vikram’s stash.

videos.title: Sauda Taakat Ka
videos.overview: Hemant saves Lakshmi, and they swap seized drugs with methi to fund their network. Dino’s death drives Lakshmi’s revenge as a raid forces Vikram to flee, haunted by Karim Kazi’s looming arrival.

videos.title: Shootout At Betalgadh
videos.overview: Tokas investigates Vikram’s drug network, but a fire destroys crucial evidence. Meanwhile, Poddar exposes Lakshmi as the thief behind the stolen drugs. Tokas arrests Vikram and Surya, but Lakshmi turns herself in. Meanwhile Kazi’s men attack the police, killing Milan.

videos.title: Checkmate
videos.overview: Devastated by her husband's death, Lakshmi is shaken but agrees to help Tokas capture Kazi, the drug lord. As she trains for revenge, Kazi's men abduct her, but she escapes. Months later, Kazi resurfaces, revealing a shocking truth that changes everything.
